observable: Reported experimental product yield ratio, using the same isomer labels as complex_1.xyz and complex_2.xyz.
interpretation_boundary: This is an experimental comparison datum, not a computed population ratio or an independently measured equilibrium constant. Do not infer a computed free-energy difference from it or assume that product yields are determined only by thermodynamics.
source: Main paper, DOI 10.1016/j.ica.2025.122961, PDF page 2, section 2.2: reported observed yield ratio at 339 K.
